description: Cast an I Ching (Yijing) hexagram with the classic three-coin method. Returns the primary hexagram (King Wen number, Chinese name, Unicode symbol), its judgment in classical Chinese with a public-domain English translation, a plain-language meaning, any moving (changing) lines, and the transformed hexagram when lines move. Optionally attach the question you have in mind.

question.description: Optional: the question or situation you are asking about. It is echoed back for context.

name: cast_hexagram
